title: Heat-Treatment of Aluminium-Nickel Composite Cold Sprayed Coating

preSprayedProperties.Powder_Blend_Ratio: 49 wt% Al, 26 wt% Ni, 25 wt% Al2O3
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Morphology: Al has an irregular shape with rounded edges, Ni is dendritic and Al2O3 are irregular in shape with sharp edges
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Particle_Size_Other: Ni particles are 13.5-35.3 μm with a D50 of 26.3 μm, Al2O3 particles are 9.1-47.7 μm with a D50 of 29.6 μm.
preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Surface_Preparation: degreased and sand-blasted with alumina powder (20Mesh).

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: the volume percent of the Al, Ni, and Al2O3 in the feedstock were 63, 16, and 21 vol% resp. and changed to 87, 5, and 8 vol% in the coating. increased density compared to lower Al content coatings. uniform distribution of all components in the coating.

Experiments.Notes: 49% Al as-spray. substrate dimensions are given as 1 mm x 25 mm x 45 mm which makes it seem like it's 45 mm thick but this seems wrong so I reported 1 mm.
